visual_brief_v2.visual_bible_contract: article-level paper, palette, accent, print, typography, photo/illustration, layout-distribution, recurring-policy, cliche and invariant rules only; no page-specific object, person, scene or action
visual_brief_v2.candidate_contract: exactly three typed concepts per page with a selected candidate id; all candidates and the final selection remain in immutable PlatformVariant metadata
visual_brief_v2.distinctness_contract: passing combinations rank before any blocked combination; block duplicate or numbered-template subjects, insufficient layout diversity, all-same anchor, cliches, compound abstractions and missing evidence
visual_brief_v2.four_page_acceptance: at least three layout families, four unique concrete subjects, explainable roles and one or more evidence refs per page; Bible contains no page-level subject
visual_brief_v2.prompt_authority: when PageVisualBrief exists it is the sole page-level semantic authority; phrase and note are local typography/cache inputs and cannot infer a second visual
visual_brief_v2.edit_contract: article edits preserve the frozen storyboard; storyboard edits preserve Bible invariants and evidence refs, rerun distinctness, refreeze the bundle and invalidate prior prompt/raw/composition traces
visual_brief_v2.legacy_contract: historical variants without visual_brief_mode stay legacy and are not backfilled or silently invalidated
visual_brief_v2.storage: metadata_json plus poster_specs; no database migration

image_candidate_v3.selection_contract: select, keep, approve and reasoned reject append audit state and preserve every competing candidate and file
image_candidate_v3.package_gate: every page needs a valid reviewed or explicitly human-approved selected candidate; candidates, Contact Sheets and raw anchors are excluded from the release ZIP

typography_recipe_v4.cover_contract: 21:9 and 1:1 visual backgrounds render without copy before the shared local typography engine overlays exact text; Playwright and Pillow fallback share the same recipe
typography_recipe_v4.legacy_contract: legacy restores the pre-V4 feathered safe-zone compositor and cover copy path without deleting or rewriting artifacts
typography_recipe_v4.package_contract: raw anchors, candidates and Contact Sheets remain excluded from the explicit release ZIP allowlist

evidence_compiler_w1.schema: strict EvidenceDocument, EvidenceChunk, EvidenceSectionRequest, EvidenceScore, SectionEvidence and EvidenceBundle with extra fields forbidden
evidence_compiler_w1.chunk_contract: semantic heading, paragraph and sentence boundaries with forced splitting only for pathological units; every chunk freezes source, material, title, author, publication/capture time, rights, editor note, original character offsets, role and content hash
evidence_compiler_w1.reference_contract: every evidence reference is exactly source_id:chunk_id and remains attached to per-section prompt payloads and immutable artifacts; traces also freeze compiler version, chunk/source counts, rank and the full score breakdown
evidence_compiler_w1.retrieval_pipeline: full-corpus local BM25 -> optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings over bounded BM25 and per-source candidates -> nine-factor rerank -> MMR diversity selection
evidence_compiler_w1.embedding_fallback: unconfigured or failed embedding providers explicitly fall back to BM25 for the compilation and never claim embedding usage
evidence_compiler_w1.section_contract: deep writing retrieves by task stage or approved outline; WeChat long-form retrieves by existing H2 or five explicit editorial questions; editorial chains retrieve four role-specific sections
evidence_compiler_w1.json_contract: bounded_json always emits parseable JSON with an explicit _x2red_prompt_compacted marker instead of slicing serialized JSON strings
evidence_compiler_w1.corpus_contract: pool compilation keeps a complete source index plus semantic summaries and evidence refs; it no longer divides a character budget equally and slices each source prefix
evidence_compiler_w1.legacy_contract: legacy emits DEGRADED_LEGACY_CHARACTER_SLICE while preserving sources, artifacts and historical versions
evidence_compiler_w1.full_verification: 172 passed, 8 warnings; CI-scoped Ruff, compileall, Python/shell/all active JavaScript syntax, publisher selector, repository JSON, sensitive-data and diff gates passed
evidence_compiler_w1.package_verification: fresh 0001-to-0012 SQLite migration and x2red 0.12.0 wheel build passed; wheel contains W1 schemas, compiler, retrieval and all production integrations
evidence_compiler_w1.runtime_safety: tests used local BM25 and synthetic fixtures; no text, image or embedding model call and no user database write

structured_writing_w2.runner_contract: strict JSON and Pydantic validation followed by at most one zero-temperature structure repair; a second failure records failed AgentRun and no ordinary success artifact
structured_writing_w2.review_contract: every issue has a stable role-prefixed id, location, severity, evidence and minimal fix; fact issues require source evidence
structured_writing_w2.chief_contract: adjudicate every reported issue exactly once and invent no issue
structured_writing_w2.final_contract: apply every approved issue and no unapproved issue; final body still passes a separate claim gate
structured_writing_w2.claim_contract: fact-isolated extractor freezes exact final quote, location, type, importance, W1 evidence refs, origin claim and approved issue ids; it cannot invent origin or approval ids
structured_writing_w2.matrix_contract: local checker verifies refs belong to the frozen W1 set, evidence quotes exist, statements are semantically related to cited chunks, origin scope and approved revisions are preserved, and exact quotes exist in the final body
blocking_contract: final claim quote missing from final body
structured_writing_w2.blocked_state: claims_blocked / claim_evidence_gate; preserve artifacts and runs, create no output DraftRevision, disable WeChat handoff
structured_writing_w2.memory_firewall: fact reviewer and claim extractor receive FACT_BOUNDARY only; memory usage is recorded only after configured-model schema success with non-empty memory ids
structured_writing_w2.legacy_contract: restore pre-W2 execution while marking every AgentRun and artifact degraded; do not rewrite history
structured_writing_w2.full_verification: 184 passed, 8 warnings; CI-scoped Ruff, compileall, Python/shell/all active JavaScript syntax, publisher selector, repository JSON and diff gates passed
structured_writing_w2.package_verification: fresh 0001-to-0012 SQLite migration and x2red 0.12.0 wheel build passed; wheel contains W2 schemas, claim checker and active UI integrations
structured_writing_w2.runtime_safety: synthetic responses and temporary databases only; no real model call and no user database write

writing_quality_w3.title_contract: generate 12-20 strict title candidates across at least five mechanisms, reject unsupported or low-quality promises and near-duplicates, run evidence-bounded first-glance reader simulation, expose five diverse finalists and freeze either an explicit human selection or the deterministic top-ranked fallback
writing_quality_w3.title_preference_contract: a human selection must reference a candidate in the latest top-five artifact; the immutable preference artifact wins over deterministic fallback and is injected as an exact non-rewritable title contract for writer and final reviser
writing_quality_w3.style_exemplar_contract: retrieve at most four short, human-approved author-original or explicitly authorized exemplars for style and structure only; prefer direct writing feedback; attach a rhetorical duty; never inject whole articles or third-party facts
writing_quality_w3.style_fact_firewall: exemplar prompts explicitly prohibit factual reuse and are never passed to evidence, fact-review or final-claim extraction roles
writing_quality_w3.author_override_contract: explicit author overrides have the highest style priority and supersede inferred profile traits, pool-memory preferences and exemplar patterns
writing_quality_w3.feedback_contract: freeze exact raw model output, direct human final revision, parent lineage, server-computed unified diff, article type, dimension labels and user reason; memory extraction remains a separate explicit human approval step
writing_quality_w3.local_verification: 191 passed, 8 warnings; Ruff, Python/JavaScript/Shell compilation, publisher regression, fresh 0001-to-0012 SQLite migration and x2red 0.12.0 wheel build passed
writing_quality_w3.blind_acceptance: the required title >=65% and style >=70% paired human blind preference rates remain pending a real human panel; unit tests and model self-review must not be reported as those rates

product_architecture.label: 内容工作台
contains: 公众号深度写作子流程

primary_flow: X/简中平台发现 -> SourceItem -> 平台分类 -> CorpusPool -> CorpusBatch -> 工作台 -> 编辑/制图/审核/发布
memory_flow: approved content/feedback/pattern/manual rule -> writing-preference candidate -> human edit/approval -> task and role scoped retrieval -> immutable selection snapshot -> real model usage -> traceable outcome

evidence_selection.ui_contract: up to 32 additive materials selected through grouped searchable checkboxes: SourceItem/CorpusBatch, DraftRevision, PlatformVariant and optional pasted content; no Command/Ctrl interaction
evidence_selection.source_input_contract: library materials and direct paste are simultaneous inputs, never either/or; paste is first materialized as a deduplicated web/manual SourceItem with rights needs_review
evidence_selection.writing_project_storage: approved immutable source_selection WritingArtifact with material_refs, material snapshots, hashes and backing source IDs
evidence_selection.wechat_variant_storage: input_material_refs, compact input_materials provenance, evidence_source_ids and evidence_sources in PlatformVariant metadata
evidence_selection.prompt_contract: raw sources are factual evidence; written versions may contribute structure and expression but facts must trace to backing raw sources; writing preferences never substitute for evidence
evidence_selection.legacy_behavior: projects created before this contract fall back to their original primary source and are not retroactively mutated
evidence_selection.frontend_consistency: root HTML is no-store and local CSS/JS URLs carry content hashes; WeChat create, editor, source-change and deep-writing handlers snapshot required controls, source IDs and material selections before async work, verify controls remain connected, and show a readable refresh error if controls are missing; the legacy style submit interceptor and its deleted #writing-source dependency are removed, while style_profile_id travels through the single studio submit snapshot
evidence_selection.race_regression: while a WeChat refresh was in flight, three rapid primary-source changes were issued and restored; the final source matched the frozen selection with no status or console error
evidence_selection.deep_writing_submit_regression: empty-material submit with all required fields reached the expected business alert and did not create a project or invoke a model; Kimi plus Fable selection restored after returning through the WeChat workbench

workflow_observability.stage_card_contract: the compact five-step rail always shows number, name, verb and textual status; one selected detail shows inputs read, output or mutation, Skill/actual model route and optimization point; system-current and user-inspected stages are distinct and color is never the only status signal
workflow_observability.artifact_contract: human-readable stage explanation remains visible while raw artifact JSON is collapsed by default; existing artifacts can be located from the stage map
workflow_observability.handoff_contract: completed deep writing passes the exact output_draft_id and frozen materials to WeChat preserve mode; existing writing projects and wechat_variant_id open the exact project/platform version instead of returning to a new-project form or guessing by source

ui_system.visual_contract: Claude-inspired warm white paper surfaces, charcoal text and terracotta primary actions; no visible decorative gradients, saturated blue-purple theme, glassmorphism or emoji structural icons
ui_system.component_contract: one semantic token set for controls, borders, radii, shadows, spacing, focus, disabled and status states; consistent outline SVG icons and minimum 44px interactive targets
ui_system.shell_contract: viewport-fixed 256px desktop sidebar with its own scrolling nav and an explicit static-HTML collapse/reopen control, 76px compact rail from 861-1360px, independently scrolling main workspace, and an <=860px accessible off-canvas drawer with scrim, inert main content, Escape close and focus return
ui_system.workspace_contract: source/configuration regions are explicitly collapsible, default collapsed at <=1360px and collapse after selecting a source, project, variant, corpus pool or memory card; WeChat preflight keeps its required material region expanded until a version exists; long source content scrolls inside the main workbench without moving the global sidebar, and route changes reset main scroll to top

xhs_workbench.runtime_contract: the global sidebar control and product-ui-v17 script are present directly in index.html; main.py does not inject a second runtime copy
xhs_workbench.collapse_contract: the global shell defaults to a 76px rail from 861-1360px and can reopen to 256px; an active source collapses the source inbox to 64px while preserving a visible reopen control
xhs_workbench.source_rail_contract: the approximately 300px expanded rail uses one labeled full-width platform selector instead of horizontally scrolling platform chips; every source row has one source-group badge, clamped title/preview metadata, and a separate minimum-44px archive or restore action
xhs_workbench.source_semantics_contract: corpus batches render as 语料池批次/冻结批次 with CORPUS BATCH READER and no X glyph, X SOURCE fallback or X original link; only actual X sources use X semantics
xhs_workbench.archive_contract: row and sticky-toolbar archive/restore actions mutate only SourceWorkbenchState(workbench=xhs); SourceItem.workspace_state remains the canonical material-library lifecycle, destructive delete stays separate, and XHS publish completion archives only the XHS workbench queue
xhs_workbench.content_priority: the source reader is the single primary column; identity metadata and delete/style/generation actions split into two rows at <=1600px, while workbench archive lives in the sticky source toolbar so every action retains usable width
xhs_workbench.inspector_contract: editor judgment and source media live in an on-demand 400px modal side drawer with aria-expanded, backdrop, focus trap, Escape close and focus return
verified_1280x720: source rail 64px collapsed and approximately 300px expanded
corpus batch has zero X glyphs
XHS archive remains visible in WeChat
restore returns the temporary copy to its original state

wechat_long_form.pipeline_ui_contract: compact five-step navigation plus one progressive detail; system-current, user-inspected stage and selected completed artifact are separate; the summary always names the inspected N/5 stage while a distinct context line names selected packaged vN; result state never impersonates aria-current; actions target exact material/editor/package regions or an existing deep-writing project; optional paste and <=860px technical facts are disclosed on demand
wechat_long_form.new_article_contract: a visible Start New Article action exits the selected project/variant but preserves all immutable history, primary source and selected materials; it confirms before discarding unsaved DOM edits, expands the preflight region and focuses the stage-2 creation action; source changes in this state do not auto-select an old artifact
wechat_long_form.preflight_workspace_contract: before a variant exists, show one full-width material workspace, keep it expanded at compact breakpoints, and hide empty editor/preview panels; after selection, a variant opens the editor and packaged preview directly
wechat_long_form.aggregate_stylesheet_contract: the /static/styles.css response is rebuilt from all modular CSS files per request, its cachebuster hashes the complete aggregate bytes, and the response is no-cache so new structural CSS cannot remain frozen from process startup
wechat_long_form.supporting_source_picker: platform-and-material-grouped searchable checkboxes for raw sources, draft revisions and platform variants, with clear and selected-count controls
wechat_long_form.removed_redundant_ui: six descriptive theme cards; the single layout-theme selector remains
wechat_long_form.completion_contract: WeChat adaptation and deep-writing writer/final_reviser use 12000 output tokens, a 360 second long-form timeout, finish_reason capture, minimum complete article, at least 3 H2, balanced and scoped code fences, no unfenced code runs and a complete terminal sentence; deep model output additionally requires at least 1200 non-whitespace characters and final revision retains at least 70 percent of a substantial initial draft; one full rewrite retry then refuse save; WeChat additionally validates illustration headings
wechat_long_form.deep_output_storage: deep final bypasses the 4000-character short-draft sanitizer and stores up to 50000 characters in DraftRevision; project payload exposes output draft id/version/character count and linked WeChat variant id/version/status
wechat_long_form.project_variant_link: WeChat metadata records writing_project_id and writing_final_artifact_id from the selected deep output draft
wechat_long_form.repair_endpoint: POST /api/platforms/variants/{variant_id}/repair-incomplete creates an immutable model or local-format repair revision and preserves the parent
wechat_long_form.repaired_article_probe: Kimi/Claude Blender v2 ended at building.name = f; complete draft v4 has 5189 characters, 8 H2, a 49-line Python block that passes ast.parse, 1615 post-code characters and zero completion issues
wechat_long_form.visual_handoff_slots: one cover slot plus one slot for every non-sources H2 section, with no silent six-section truncation
wechat_long_form.visual_prompt_contract: precise Chinese prompt with placement, excerpt, composition, theme colors, 16:9 ratio, central cover crop safety, and no text/logo/watermark/UI or unsupported facts
wechat_long_form.visual_asset_contract: validate and normalize the uploaded image, store it as an Asset with rights needs_review, invalidate old outputs and require package rebuild
wechat_long_form.render_contract: cover asset feeds local 21:9 and 1:1 covers; section assets follow matching H2; preview, Markdown, clean HTML, manifest, ZIP and visual-handoff.md stay version-aligned
wechat_long_form.verification: automated round trip used a synthetic PNG; real Codex/ImageGen quality and human copyright/fact review remain required

database.source_archive_contract: SourceItem.workspace_state is canonical material-library state; source_workbench_states stores independent active/archived queues by source_id and workbench

pool_memory.approval_contract: extraction creates a candidate only; formal cards require explicit human approval and authorization confirmation when source rights are not already approved
pool_memory.retrieval: hard scope filtering, task similarity, source priority, recency and usage scoring; dedupe per source; default 4-8 cards
pool_memory.fact_firewall: writing preferences control how to write, never what facts are allowed; evidence roles receive no style-memory payload; explicit primary/supporting sources control factual scope; raw examples are withheld from ordinary memory prompts and only short authorized W3 exemplars may enter non-factual writer/title/final roles
pool_memory.lifecycle: append-only approve, supersede and revoke; no physical-overwrite API
pool_memory.snapshot_contract: freeze selected IDs, role-scoped prompt payload and hash per target; clone for derived versions; never mutate the old target snapshot
pool_memory.usage_truth: PoolMemoryUsage is appended only after a configured model actually consumes memory; deterministic fallback preserves provenance but remains applied=false
integrations: XHS native skill copy and visual prompts

light_content.storyboard_copy_root_cause: article save called _sync_light_storyboard, which replaced every frozen phrase and note with consecutive article sentences and created the exact page-N-note equals page-(N+1)-phrase chain
light_content.mode_isolation: long-form and light-content are mutually exclusive tabs in one WeChat entry; light mode hides the five-step long-form pipeline, article editor and article preview and exposes only the four-step light workflow
light_content.scroll_contract: the global sidebar remains fixed and explicitly reopenable while the main workspace scrolls independently; the light stage rail and current-page inspector remain sticky within that scroll container
light_content.visual_brief_contract: production variants freeze one article-level VisualBible, exactly three candidates per page, the selected PageVisualBrief, distinctness report and source fingerprint; no series_motif is propagated across the page set
light_content.visual_brief_editor_contract: the storyboard UI exposes role, concrete subject, action/relation, setting, viewpoint, crop, lighting, reader emotion, evidence refs, candidate count and Bible invariants; backend refreezes and rejects invariant or distinctness violations

chatgpt_web_handoff.contract: save and fingerprint the current storyboard, run the same v0.3 text compiler used by API render without calling an image API, let the user generate and save in ChatGPT Images web, upload each image as an external raw anchor, and compose Chinese/final layout locally; prompt becomes stale after any semantic compiler input changes; partial imports produce page previews but no publish package
chatgpt_web_handoff.prompt_ui_contract: explicitly compile and display the complete prompt plus compiler mode, skill version, recipe, warnings, source/prompt fingerprints and diff before enabling separate copy, ChatGPT Images link and upload actions
chatgpt_web_handoff.stale_contract: any storyboard edit immediately marks the previous prompt stale and disables copy, external navigation and upload until a new prompt is generated and checked
chatgpt_web_handoff.runtime_mismatch_contract: a 404 Not Found from a new frontend against an old Python process is translated into an instruction to restart X2RED and refresh
chatgpt_web_handoff.automation: manual copy, browser generation/save and upload; no OpenAI API and no hidden account automation

light_content.copy_quality_contract: article edits preserve existing storyboard copy byte-for-byte; generation and candidate selection reject same-page and cross-page equal or near-equal phrase/note pairs; storyboard POST repeats the gate and returns a readable 400 instead of freezing a collision
light_content.evidence_scope_contract: corpus-batch generation records full-pool source count, pool characters, frozen detailed source IDs/count and submitted characters; each poster stores and displays evidence_basis and source_refs; writing preferences never replace current evidence
storyboard_behavior: persist current candidate/editor before visual work
preserve frozen phrase and note when article fields are saved
reject same-page or cross-page equal and near-equal copy
store and display per-page evidence basis and source refs
Chinese labels for exact enum controls
render requests do not author editorial content
fixed_behavior: persist current editor fields without rewriting storyboard copy
force refresh and select returned version
clear stale draft and variant before async source loading
discard outdated responses with request tokens
default to local renderer; Minimal Zine requires explicit experimental selection

non_negotiables: keep the three-layer information architecture
do not collapse all sources into one unclassified selector
signal studio discovers X and material library discovers Simplified-Chinese platforms
all discovery paths converge on SourceItem
pasted long-form content must be materialized as a reviewable SourceItem before generation
corpus batches freeze memory, detailed sources, revision and provenance
pool-memory cards require human approval and remain separate from factual evidence
every comparison must explicitly select supporting factual sources; writing preferences cannot supply missing evidence
every production writing agent output must pass its strict schema or one bounded repair; degraded and legacy outputs cannot masquerade as validated success
reviewers must emit located evidenced issues, chief may only adjudicate reported issue ids, and final may only execute approved issue ids
critical or major unsupported final claims and unauthorized major claim expansions must block completion and WeChat handoff
title selection is limited to the latest diverse top-five tournament result; a valid human preference overrides the deterministic top-ranked fallback and is frozen for downstream roles
style exemplars must be short, human-approved author-original or explicitly authorized samples with rhetorical duties; they must not contribute third-party facts or whole-article text
writing feedback must preserve direct model-to-human lineage and a server-computed diff; user edits override model output and memory learning still requires explicit approval
WeChat long-form, light-content and deep-writing source selections remain independent
archiving a source inside one content workbench must not remove it from the material library or any other workbench
deep writing remains an optional WeChat subflow; its full DraftRevision and the final WeChat PlatformVariant are distinct immutable outputs with an explicit link
pool-memory retrieval is task-scoped and role-scoped; factual agents receive no style memory
derived versions freeze or clone immutable memory selection snapshots
only real model consumption creates memory usage records
render light content from current candidate and current editor text
saving light-content article fields must preserve existing storyboard phrase and note instead of regenerating them from consecutive body sentences
light-content poster copy must pass same-page and cross-page duplicate checks and retain per-page factual provenance
Visual Bible defines only project-level how-to-render invariants and must never contain page-specific subjects
production Minimal Zine pages require a frozen PageVisualBrief selected from three candidates and passing series distinctness; one series_motif cannot populate every page
Prompt compilation must treat the frozen PageVisualBrief as the sole page-level visual authority and invalidate prior prompt traces after storyboard semantics change
API-generated and manually uploaded Minimal Zine anchors must use the same candidate lifecycle and review gate
selecting, rejecting or repairing an image candidate must preserve every competing candidate and its provenance
automatic image repair is limited to one directed attempt per page and must repeat frozen references and invariants
unreviewed, failed, rejected or stale image candidates must not enter a publish package
every production final-text target freezes a strict local typography recipe and must pass overflow and protected-subject checks
safe_zone_caption is a collision fallback, not the default mode for every page
external long-form visuals remain slot-scoped Assets and require package rebuild plus human fact/copyright/watermark review
do not delegate final Chinese typography to image models
final publishing remains a human action
recheck GitHub status before relying on snapshot state
